title: A pointwise 2-converse for elliptic curves with rational two-torsion
summary: We prove a pointwise 2-converse for elliptic curves over $`\mathbf Q`$ with nonzero rational two-torsion: if the $`2^\infty`$-Selmer corank is zero or one, then the analytic rank and Mordell–Weil rank equal that corank, and the Shafarevich–Tate group is finite. The result allows arbitrary reduction at 2.

review.reason: Proves a pointwise 2-converse relating Selmer corank, analytic rank, and Mordell-Weil rank.
